author: ConnorCuriousUS
text:
That video really does sell the leap. GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI’s new flagship, they call it the most intelligent and aligned model yet, built for computer use, coding, science, and professional workflows. It posts 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4, 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3, and 100% on ExploitBench, and it’s rolling out first to a limited set of orgs before hitting Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users. 

Some OpenAI leaders even framed it as the start of the AGI era. 

Full recap here: https://t.co/M5t4uXihq9

author: JanCernohorsky1
text:
I know this is just a capabilities demo and probably not meant to be a literal vision of the future. But from a marketing perspective I still think the setting is a missed opportunity.

Show the same thing, but then close the laptop and go fishing, play golf, hike, spend time with your kids - while Astra keeps working and you occasionally talk to it through your phone.

That’s a future I’d find much more exciting.

Feels like they could have played way more on the emotions of people and get them more if the premise was just better in my opinion.
